frontmatter.name: hill-causation-check
frontmatter.description: Assess whether X really causes Y — or is only correlated with it — using the 9 Bradford Hill viewpoints (1965). Use when a headline, post, paper, or chatbot claims that something causes, prevents, or cures a disease or health outcome, or when you need a structured evidence-strength verdict (STRONG / PLAUSIBLE / WEAK ASSOCIATION / NOT ESTABLISHED) with a scorecard. This skill judges strength of evidence, not personal medical advice.
